Those '''droids''', the head of which somewhat resembled the one of the [[EV-series supervisor droid/Legends|EV-series supervisor droid]], were used by the [[Nightsisters/Legends|Nightsisters]] of [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]]. Around [[31 BBY/Legends|31 BBY]], such droids were seen serving drinks to [[Queen/Legends|Queen]] [[Zalem/Legends|Zalem]] and her fellow [[Sister (Witches of Dathomir)|Sisters]] under a [[Tent/Legends|tent]].<ref name="IE3" />
